subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Demand Review Meetings
description: A quick, practical guide to Demand Review Meetings.

hook.text: The forecast said 5,000 units. Actual demand was 8,000. Nobody asked why until the quarterly review—too late.

buildup.text: Demand review meetings are regular sessions where teams compare forecasts to actuals and adjust plans.

discovery.text: They catch errors early, identify emerging trends, and incorporate new market intelligence into the forecast.

twist.text: Skipping reviews saves time short-term but lets errors compound. A small miss becomes a big miss fast.

climax.text: Weekly reviews for fast-moving goods and monthly reviews for stable ones keep forecasts fresh and relevant.

punchline.text: Review the forecast or watch it drift from reality.

quiz.question: Why are regular demand review meetings important?
options: To catch errors early and update plans
